functions.name: core_stepper_init
functions.signature: core_stepper_init(core_stepper_t * h, uint8_t step_pad, uint8_t dir_pad)
functions.brief: Bind a stepper axis to a STEP pad (timer output) and a DIR pad. The timer and channel come from the pad's TIMx.y assignment in config.json, which is also what routes the pin to the timer. Loads conservative defaults: 1000 steps/s cruise, 100 steps/s start, 4000 steps/s^2 ramp, 8 us pulses. The timer is left stopped until a move. Do not share the timer with a PWM output — the module rewrites its period on every step.

params.name: step_pad
params.description: Pad wired to the driver's STEP / PUL input; must carry a TIMx.y function.

params.name: dir_pad
params.description: Pad wired to the driver's DIR input.

functions.name: core_stepper_init_ch
functions.signature: core_stepper_init_ch(core_stepper_t * h, TIM_TypeDef * instance, uint8_t channel, uint8_t step_pad, uint8_t dir_pad)
functions.brief: Bind an axis with an explicit timer instance and channel (no coregen lookup). The caller must have configured the STEP pad's alternate function for that channel. Everything else as core_stepper_init().

params.name: channel
params.description: Output channel wired to the STEP pad.

params.name: step_pad
params.description: STEP pad (recorded only; its AF is the caller's job).

params.name: dir_pad
params.description: Pad wired to the driver's DIR input.

functions.name: core_stepper_set_enable_pad
functions.brief: Add an ENABLE output. The pad is driven to its disabled level immediately; call core_stepper_enable() to power the driver. Pass pad 0 to remove it.

params.name: en_pad
params.description: Pad wired to the driver's ENA input (0 = none).

params.name: active_low
params.description: true if the driver enables on a LOW level.

functions.name: core_stepper_enable
functions.brief: Drive the ENABLE pad. No effect without core_stepper_set_enable_pad(). Motion is not interlocked: halt before disabling if you care where the rotor ends up.

functions.name: core_stepper_set_polarity
functions.signature: core_stepper_set_polarity(core_stepper_t * h, bool step_active_low, bool dir_invert)
functions.brief: Set signal polarities. Call while idle.

params.name: step_active_low
params.description: true if the driver steps on the FALLING edge (STEP idles high).

params.name: dir_invert
params.description: true to swap which DIR level counts as positive.

functions.name: core_stepper_set_pulse_us
functions.brief: Set the STEP pulse width; the low time between pulses is kept at least as long, which also bounds DIR setup. 8 us (default) satisfies the DM320T's 7.5 us; a DRV8428 is happy with 1 us. The maximum step rate is 1 / (2 * pulse_us).

functions.name: core_stepper_set_speed
functions.brief: Set the cruise rate for position moves and the cap for run(). Takes effect at the next step; a move in flight ramps to the new value.

functions.name: core_stepper_set_accel
functions.brief: Set the acceleration used for every ramp, or 0 to switch instantly between the start rate and full speed (fine for small, unloaded motors at low rates; expect stalls otherwise).

functions.name: core_stepper_set_min_speed
functions.brief: Set the rate a ramp starts from and stops at. Steppers can start instantly at a few hundred full steps per second; starting from a crawl only wastes time. Clamped to at least 1 (16 on a 16-bit timer).

functions.name: core_stepper_move
functions.brief: Move a signed number of microsteps relative to the current target (so two quick calls of +160 travel 320). Retargets a move in flight; a reversal decelerates to the start rate before flipping DIR.

params.name: steps
params.description: Microsteps, negative for the reverse direction.

functions.name: core_stepper_move_to
functions.brief: Move to an absolute microstep position.

functions.name: core_stepper_run
functions.brief: Run continuously at a signed rate, ramping from the current speed. Rate 0 decelerates to a stop (same as core_stepper_stop()). The magnitude is capped at the cruise rate from core_stepper_set_speed().

functions.name: core_stepper_stop
functions.brief: Decelerate to a stop using the configured acceleration. Position continues to count during the ramp. Idempotent.

functions.name: core_stepper_halt
functions.brief: Stop instantly: timer off, STEP forced to idle. A pulse whose rising edge the driver has already seen is counted. A loaded motor at speed will lose steps; the position counter reflects the pulses sent.

functions.name: core_stepper_busy
functions.brief: true while pulses are being generated (including a ramp to zero).

functions.name: core_stepper_state
functions.brief: Current motion state.

functions.name: core_stepper_position
functions.brief: Current signed microstep position (pulses actually issued).

functions.name: core_stepper_set_position
functions.brief: Redefine the current position without moving (homing). Only while idle; the target follows so the next move() is relative to it.

params.name: position
params.description: New value for the current position.

functions.name: core_stepper_target
functions.brief: Target position of the current or last move.

functions.name: core_stepper_speed
functions.brief: Current signed step rate.

functions.name: core_stepper_stop_distance
functions.brief: Microsteps needed to decelerate from `steps_per_s` to the start rate at the configured acceleration. Useful for planning where a run() will stop, e.g. to land on a pocket boundary.
